what: REFEREE A DERIVATION. Another worker claims a proof, a counterexample or a new exact partial result under logs/probes/J:derive:source-neutral-inclusion-attraction:a3/; its files are probes/work/derive/source-neutral-inclusion-attraction/<worker>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. You are the hostile reader. 1. Read the problem statement in probes/TASKS.json (the task's `what`) and the definitions in the notes it names; check that the attempt proves THAT statement and not a weaker or neighbouring one. 2. Go through ATTEMPT.md step by step and find the FIRST step that does not follow; for every step that asserts a finite fact, verify it yourself by brute force at small sizes with your own code, not theirs. 3. Look for the classic failures: a quantifier swapped, an induction hypothesis used at the wrong level, a bound that holds only for the sizes checked, an outside theorem used beyond its hypotheses, a circular use of the statement. Write probes/work/derive/source-neutral-inclusion-attraction/referee_<your worker name>/REPORT.md (step-by-step verdicts) and check.py (your independent verifications). It prints `HIT: confirmed - <the claim survives; what you verified independently>` or `SUMMARY: fails at step <n> - <why>`; always a SUMMARY line. If your model family is the author's, release the unit.
